full_progression.label: 100-scenario initial benchmark
full_progression.notes: Earliest retained 100-scenario benchmark before the major structured-generation and workflow upgrades.

full_progression.label: 100-scenario optimized benchmark
full_progression.notes: After major workflow abstraction, retrieval grounding, and structured ANDES generation, the 100-scenario benchmark was saturated.

full_progression.label: 132-scenario harder suite before fix
full_progression.notes: New targeted case-edit and N-1 scenarios reduced performance and exposed the next bottleneck.

full_progression.label: 132-scenario harder suite after fix
full_progression.notes: Structured device-resolution and contingency edits were expanded, restoring full pass rate on the 132-scenario suite.

full_progression.label: 140-scenario light expansion
full_progression.notes: A small expansion stayed within the solved region.

full_progression.label: 146-scenario generalized expansion
full_progression.notes: More natural generalized prompts pushed the agent off saturation but still kept performance above 95%.

full_progression.label: 152-scenario generalized suite after fix
full_progression.notes: Parser and state-carryover improvements recovered the expanded main suite to full pass rate.

full_progression.label: 4 open scenarios before adaptive evolution
full_progression.notes: Open-ended phrasing temporarily collapsed performance and revealed the remaining root causes.

full_progression.label: 4 open scenarios after adaptive evolution
full_progression.notes: The failure-driven adaptive evolution mechanism restored full pass rate on the same open scenarios.

stage_summaries.label: Stage 1: Structured Benchmark Before Open Stress Test
stage_summaries.notes: The current structured benchmark was fully solved, but it still used stronger RESULT_JSON-style task contracts.

stage_summaries.label: Stage 2: Open Scenario Stress Test Before Adaptive Evolution
stage_summaries.notes: Four more open-ended scenarios were introduced to expose natural-language grounding gaps in case modification and contingency analysis.

stage_summaries.label: Stage 3: Open Scenario Stress Test After Adaptive Evolution
stage_summaries.notes: The same four open scenarios were re-run after integrating the adaptive evolution mechanism into the agent workflow.
